facts.note: Girard kept his watch in his pocket when Monnier asked for watches, sat alone in the dining room with the brandy, and heard the temple strike ten without looking at his watch.
He went into the street to smoke at twenty-one minutes past ten by his watch and stayed under the front windows of the house.
The piano started in the salon as he lit his cigar at twenty-nine minutes past ten by his watch, and stopped at eighteen minutes to eleven by his watch.
At twenty-six minutes to eleven by his watch he heard faint quick bells from the master's window above, with the piano playing all the while.
He came back in at fourteen minutes to eleven by his watch; the hall clock had just struck eleven and its face showed two minutes past eleven; he then went up to Félix in the library.

added.quote: At nine Monnier had made us all show our watches, as he does every year.
added.why: Fixes a clock reading of nine o'clock during the evening, before the temple struck ten. The watch-showing happened at nine, so a detective now has an earlier anchor point for the evening than the sheet gives.
